Three of the changes move scores:
- #34293: a `pending_confirmation` operation now has to make the confirmed write too.
- #34294: an operation no longer inherits an earlier turn's write.
- #34296: the control cards now ask 14 / 14 / 13 questions, and Chinese asks are on.

Compare runs only on or after `f59a4aa0`.

New tool: `objectstack-scenarios summary <dir>` (#34295) builds the author × ask table from your run records.

Owed to you: any M3 close-out run, plus the M2 recommendation card (cloud haiku + effort medium) if eval#1 did not file it. The epic seat has clocked out, and the epic has no PM seat now.
